name: airbnb-listing-detail
description: Fetches complete Airbnb listing details for a given numeric listing ID via the internal GraphQL API, returning title, room type, description, amenities, photos, coordinates, city, house rules, highlights, ratings, review count, bedroom configuration, and property overview. Use when user mentions Airbnb listing details, Airbnb property info, Airbnb room details, get Airbnb listing data, Airbnb amen
